purpose: Prevent agents and fill paths from placing private-cloud document links into employer-visible resume/CV/transcript/cover URL fields.
allowed_examples: applicant-controlled public HTTPS PDF resume URLs when the employer field asks for a PDF
forbidden_examples: https://www.perezparallax.dev/static/resume/current.html when the employer field asks for a PDF
pdf_labeled_field_rule: When the field label mentions PDF, the URL path must end with .pdf. Leave the optional field blank rather than pasting an HTML resume page.

privacy.rule: Employer ATS fields must not receive Google Drive/Docs links that require the employer's Google account access or expose private Drive ACL assumptions.
